description.en: Maintained by the Video Reader author. Reader, shared tasks and Scroll are shipped together.
description.zh: 项目作者维护的索引，整包包含 Reader、通用任务和 Scroll。

title.zh: 视频阅读 Video Reader + Scroll

description.en: Windows. Read Bilibili, YouTube and local videos with timestamped text and images. Includes shared queues/history and Scroll's independent Bilibili account, inbox and authorized delivery workflows. Reuses an existing local installation; scheduled workflows remain in trial.
description.zh: Windows。读取 B 站、YouTube 和本地视频，带时间点追问文字与画面。整包接入通用队列/历史、Scroll 独立 B 站账号、私信收件与授权投递。复用已安装核心；定时工作流仍在试用。
